statement: A reviewing session wrote one goal card for four v27 B3 issues (#627 to #630, twelve sub-items) and set expected_runtime_minutes to 90, equal to the session watchdog (5400 s). The agent committed every fix and the measured records, then the watchdog stopped it during its final full-suite run: no PR description, no hand-back, a scratch note auto-committed, and a vitest run left orphaned in the worktree. The grammar check only warns above the limit, so a card sized to exactly the limit passes clean. Rule: size a card to leave a third of the limit for the final suite and the hand-back; split work that needs the whole limit, ordering the false-credit items first.
